sn47.15:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Bāhiyo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || [pe] || ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Bāhiyo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn47.15:1.3: Sādhu me bhante saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yaṃ aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho apamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti ||
sn47.15:1.4: Tasmā ti ha tvam Bāhiya ādim eva visodhehi kusalesu dhammesu || ||
sn47.15:1.7: Yato ca kho te Bāhiya sīlañca suvisuddham bhavissati diṭṭhi ca ujukā || tato tvam Bāhiya sīlam nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bhāveyyāsi ||
sn47.15:2.2: Idha tvam Bāhiya kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.15:2.5: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāhi || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn47.15:2.6: Yato kho tvam Bāhiya sīlam nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evam bhāvessasi || tato tuyham Bāhiya yā ratti vā divaso vā āgamissasi || vuddhi yeva paṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihānī ti || || 5.
sn47.15:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Bāhiyo Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || 6.
sn47.15:3.2: Atha kho āyasmā Bāhiyo eko vupakaṭṭho apamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi ||
sn47.15:3.3: Khīnā jāti vusitam brahmacariyam kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam ittatthāyā ti abbhaññāsi || || 7.
sn47.15:3.4: Aññataro ca panāyasmā Bāhiyo arahatam ahosī ti || || 1.
